name: n-skills
description: Curated plugin marketplace for AI agents - works with Claude Code, Codex, and openskills

plugins.name: zai-cli
plugins.description: Z.AI vision, search, reader, and GitHub exploration via MCP

plugins.name: dev-browser
plugins.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows.

plugins.name: gastown
plugins.description: Multi-agent orchestrator for Claude Code. Use when user mentions gastown, gas town, gt commands, convoys, polecats, rigs, slinging work, multi-agent coordination, beads, hooks, the witness, the mayor, the refinery, or wants to run multiple AI agents on projects simultaneously.

plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: Multi-agent orchestration for complex tasks using cc-mirror tasks and TodoWrite. Use when tasks require parallel work, multiple agents, sophisticated coordination, or decomposition into parallel subtasks.

plugins.name: open-source-maintainer
plugins.description: End-to-end GitHub repository maintenance for open-source projects. Use when asked to triage issues, review PRs, analyze contributor activity, generate maintenance reports, or maintain a repository. Triggers include "triage", "maintain", "review PRs", "analyze issues", "repo maintenance", "what needs attention", "open source maintenance", or any request to understand and act on GitHub issues/PRs.

plugins.name: x-twitter-scraper
plugins.description: Use Xquik for X/Twitter search, profiles, timelines, exports, monitoring, webhooks, SDK or MCP setup, and explicitly approved publishing. Read-only by default. Use when agents need structured X data or a bounded X workflow. Not affiliated with X Corp.
